title: Devil's Taunt
body:
Syntax: perform devils taunt <target>

Description: An illusion that can stun and stop an action.  Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 24-29. 45% chance to inflict stunned. The effect lasts 10 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 20. Costs 20 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
